director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj fractions ko number line par cricket pitch jaise dekhenge. Cricket mein tumhe kya pasand hai?
haan

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai.
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur theek beech mein ek mark. Yeh mark 0 se 1 ko 2 barabar gaps mein baant raha hai, aur is mark ka naam 1/2 hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe nahi pata

0 se 1 ki line ko 2 barabar gaps mein baanto. Beech wala mark 1/2 hai, aur woh 0 aur 1 ke beech hi hai. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

Marks nahi, gaps dekho: 4 barabar gaps hain, isliye 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/4 hai. Isi rekha ke neeche ki taraf beech mein 7 marks hain. Yahan tak theek hai?

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 10 barabar gaps ka har gap 5 gaps wale gap se chhota hai, toh 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas rukta hai. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 km par. Ghar aur school ke beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par lage hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne km door hai? Diya hai: ghar 0 par aur school 1 km par hai, aur beech mein 3 khambe barabar doori par hain. Dhoondhna hai: pehle khambe ki ghar se doori, km mein. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
haan samajh gayi
Pehla kadam dekho. Rekha banao aur ghar ko 0 par, school ko 1 par likho: 0 se 1 tak ki rekha, kyunki 0 se 1 tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
pata nahi
Ghar ko 0 par aur school ko 1 par rakho. Ghar se school tak ka poora raasta ek poora hai. Chalo, aage dekhte hain.
theek hai
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe nahi, beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech ke nishaan se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain. Ab isse aage chalte hain.
aapko virat pasand hai?

Screen par 0 se 1 tak ki rekha hai, aur beech mein 2 nishaan barabar doori par hain. 0 ke baad pehla nishaan kaunsa bhinn hai?

theek hai
Screen par 0 se 1 ki rekha 3 barabar gaps mein bati hai. 0 se 2 hop lage hain, har hop 1/3 ka, aur hum 2/3 wale nishaan par pahunche. 2/3 ek hi jagah hai, ek hi number. Yahan tak theek hai?
haan
Ab rekha ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto aur 0 se 3 hop lo. Kis bhinn par pahunchoge?
director.card: Ab rekha ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto aur 0 se 3 hop lo. Kis bhinn par pahunchoge?

director.text: Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. 0 se 2 hop lo, aur tum 2/3 par pahunchte ho. Ab rekha ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto aur 0 se 3 hop lo. Kis bhinn par pahunchoge?
director.card: Ab rekha ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto aur 0 se 3 hop lo. Kis bhinn par pahunchoge?

director.text: three quarters

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki har hop 1/4 ka hai aur 0 se 3 hop liye, toh hum 3/4 par hain. Screen par teesra hop dekho: woh theek 1 par utra, aur wahan likha hai 3/3 = 1. 3/3 mein upar aur neeche barabar hain, isliye hop theek 1 par khatam hue. Agar har hop 1/5 ka ho, toh 0 se chalkar theek 1 tak pahunchne mein kitne hop lagenge?

director.text: Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Teesra hop theek 1 par utarta hai, isliye wahan 3/3 = 1 likha hai. Jab upar aur neeche barabar hon, hop theek 1 par khatam hote hain. Agar har hop 1/5 ka ho, toh 0 se chalkar theek 1 tak pahunchne mein kitne hop lagenge?

director.text: Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 5 hai, kyunki har hop 1/5 ka hai, aur 5 hop milkar 5/5 = 1 banate hain. Screen par 0 se 1 ki rekha 6 barabar gaps mein bati hai. Beech wala nishaan 3/6 hai, yaani 1/2, kyunki 3, 6 ka aadha hai. Rekha par 2/6 aur 5/6 bhi likhe hain: 2/6 beech se pehle, 5/6 beech ke baad. Yahan tak theek hai?
haan
Isi rekha par 4/6 kahaan aayega: beech se pehle ya beech ke baad?

director.card: Isi rekha par 4/6 kahaan aayega: beech se pehle ya beech ke baad?

director.text: before the middle

Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Iska jawab beech ke baad hai, kyunki beech 3/6 hai, aur 4/6 mein 4 gaps hain, 3 se zyada, toh 4/6 beech ke baad hai. Ek sankhya rekha 0 se 1 tak hai. Is rekha par 2/5 kahaan aayega, woh nishaan dhoondo. Diya hai: rekha 0 se 1 tak hai, aur bhinn 2/5 mein neeche 5 aur upar 2 hai. Dhoondhna hai: 2/5 wala nishaan. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
